title: Free Grotti Turismo Omaggio and Rockstar Motorsport Livery Via GTA Online Twitch Drops
description: RockstarINTEL reports that Rockstar Games and Twitch are offering GTA Online players a free Grotti Turismo Omaggio supercar and Rockstar Motorsport livery via Twitch Drops from October 30 through November 1, 2026.
youtubeTitle: GTA Online: Free Grotti Turismo Omaggio and Livery Via Twitch Drops
socialHook: GTA Online players can claim a free Grotti Turismo Omaggio and rare livery by watching NoPixel V Twitch streams this weekend.

sections.heading: Twitch Drops Reward Details
paragraphs: RockstarINTEL reported that Rockstar Games and Twitch have partnered to bring back Twitch Drops for GTA V, offering players a free Grotti Turismo Omaggio supercar and the Rockstar Motorsport Livery. The outlet said the car is worth $2,845,000 at Legendary Motorsport and that the livery previously appeared on the Pegassi Zentorno through GTA+ earlier this year.

According to RockstarINTEL, the Drops run from October 30 through November 1, 2026, and players must watch select NoPixel V roleplay streamers on Twitch for four hours to earn the rewards. The streamers will display the NoPixel V server logo in their names, and only streams with Drops Enabled count. Rewards must be claimed by Monday, November 2 at 11:59 BST, and players must have their Rockstar Games account connected to Twitch.

sections.heading: Eligibility Steps and Unanswered Details
paragraphs: RockstarINTEL noted that the rewards will be usable in the vanilla version of GTA Online on all consoles and PC. The report did not specify the full list of participating streamers, whether the car and livery are permanent unlocks, or if any additional in-game requirements apply beyond the watch time. Rockstar Games has not issued a separate announcement in the coverage cited by RockstarINTEL.
